core_competencies.name: Customer empathy
core_competencies.description: Listens, de-escalates, and communicates clearly with customers under stress.

core_competencies.name: Suitability and trust
core_competencies.description: Balances customer needs, product fit, disclosure, compliance, and long-term trust.

core_competencies.name: Ownership and escalation
core_competencies.description: Owns customer issues, knows when to escalate, and follows through.

core_competencies.name: Service-to-sales judgment
core_competencies.description: Identifies opportunities without pressuring or mis-selling.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Shows empathy, clarity, and calm problem solving.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How would you respond if the customer remains upset?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Explains fit, alternatives, risks, and disclosure.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Focuses on closing a sale because the customer asked.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What would make this product unsuitable?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Names policy, escalation, documentation, or risk boundaries.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Ignores compliance or treats it as a blocker.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Improves customer trust and solves the real need.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Measures success only by speed or volume.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How would you know the customer was helped appropriately?
